description: Make CSS-only triangles from borders: pick a direction, size and color, preview it live, and copy the snippet.

faqs.a: The triangle is made from a zero-size element with thick borders — it is resolution-independent and stays crisp at any zoom.
faqs.q: Are the triangles sharp on retina screens?

faqs.a: For IE11 support, the code works as-is since it uses only classic border properties.
faqs.q: Do I need any fallback for old browsers?

faqs.a: The generator emits only the triangle; add margin, float or a wrapper class in your own CSS to position it.
faqs.q: How do I position the triangle in my layout?

howto: Choose a direction (up, down, left, right).
Set the triangle size and pick a color.
Click "Copy CSS" and paste the snippet into your stylesheet.
title: CSS Triangle Generator
